objectives.description: Add no-abort case for missing library at both candidate paths
Assert status write / extension hook / lifecycle event still run on stale path
Assert no code path writes specs/.freshness-warn-streak.json

approaches_tried.approach: Asserted the events-append.sh stderr WARNING text as the lifecycle-event proxy
approaches_tried.reason: that warning is one-time-per-process (_EVENTS_APPEND_OBSERVABLE_WARNED guard) and had already fired in an earlier group in the same suite process; switched to asserting the unconditional .claude/tmp/events-append-observable.log sentinel append instead

approaches_tried.approach: Called skill_preflight_update after a bare `cd` into the fixture without overriding SKILL_REPO_ROOT
approaches_tried.reason: SKILL_REPO_ROOT is exported once, process-wide, at this suite's top-of-file source and is not updated by `cd`; the freshness helper read the REAL repo's own (accidentally-stale, mid-implementation) .claude-extensions.json instead of the fixture's fabricated one -- fixed by prefixing each call with SKILL_REPO_ROOT="$FIXTURE_ROOT", matching Group 3's existing skill_link_artifacts idiom

approaches_tried.approach: Reused the same --seq value for both the stale and clean orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh fixture runs and diffed the dispatch file PATH captured from each
approaches_tried.reason: both calls resolve to the identical dispatch file path (keyed by task+seq), so the second run overwrote the first before the diff read it; fixed by snapshotting the stale run's content to a separate WORKDIR file immediately after that call

notes: Deliberate-break verification (Phase 5 verification bullet 3) done via an isolated ad hoc probe sourcing the SOURCE-STORE skill-base.sh directly (never touching .claude/**), confirming WARN_ABSENT when broken and WARN_PRESENT after restoring the source-store file byte-identical. test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh: 35/35 pass, shellcheck clean. test-orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh: 79/79 pass, shellcheck clean.
